name: Bharti Airtel
title: Transcript of the Earnings Call dated November 6, 2026.

read.thesis: Airtel India ARPU rose to Rs271 from Rs264 on a pricing reset and premiumisation, but capex discipline is only partly evidenced and home-broadband quality remains soft, with no supply-side tightening in the industry.

capex.quote: the radio capex has kind of moderated, and that will continue because a lot of the build -out has already happened

triggers.label: ARPU Rs264 → Rs271 sequentially
triggers.quote: ARPU for the quarter came in at Rs.271, up from 264

triggers.label: New tower installs under 1000 this year
triggers.quote: if you look at the new towers being installed, it is almost very little now it is less than 1000

triggers.label: Third player investing, churn up
triggers.quote: this is happening at a time when the third player has started investing

triggers.label: Home broadband net adds slowed to 670,000
triggers.quote: In homes, we delivered net adds of 670,000.

guidance.metric: Industry ARPU growth 4-5% a year over 5-7 years
guidance.value: not repeated; management said structural pricing change needs industry to move
guidance.quote: that change of architecture will require, like, I think the industry to move more decisively

prior_guidance_check.metric: Industry tariff architecture ARPU growth 4-5% a year over 5-7 years
prior_guidance_check.quote: the architecture correction is a much broader correction that is required in the industry to charge for data in many ways

red_flags.label: Home broadband EBIT margin deteriorating, low-ARPU acquisition
red_flags.quote: we had seen some issues in terms of quality of acquisition at low ARPUs

red_flags.label: Churn up, Q2 pricing intervention
red_flags.quote: there is always a temporary impact on customer continuity

red_flags.label: Capex vs CWIP reconciliation gap
red_flags.quote: Capex and WIP mismatch, well, this will continue to happen for large projects

evasions.quote: I do not have a ready answer for you, Aditya. Allow me to circle back to you on this one.
I would not speculate beyond a point on this.
I would not comment beyond that.
